markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement, invasive probability under 1% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, Normal 2% | Benign clearly leads |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0, no flag | No input warning |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign, 3 Normal | Neighbors split |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scored below typical; concept model leans benign [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored above typical; lower invasive association [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored below typical; slight pull toward benign · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scored low; spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002; −0.005 to 0.007), so concepts are not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on mitoses, which is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The image has simulated blur (severity 3); fine nuclear detail may be lost despite the high reliability score.
- Only 2 of 5 similar cases are Benign; three are Normal, so Benign-versus-Normal is less certain.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 7, 11**: Confirm fibrous stroma or fat; exclude infiltrating tumor cells.
2. **Region 0**: Count mitoses by eye; the concept score failed spot checks.
3. **Region 11**: Assess nuclear pleomorphism; blur may mask atypia.
